description: What happened last time, for the DM who prepares a session: the closed session before the one given (the given one itself when it is closed) — its id, order (the session number), title and date — with the summary generated at its closing and summaryMeta, one line saying which model wrote it and when it was edited (null while there is no summary). Only a session in status closed has one (SessionLifecycle@1). A campaign with no closed session yet has no summary: session, summary and summaryMeta are null, never an error. The journal lines are another read. mentions and threads are always empty: no table keeps them.
output: { session: { id: string, order: number, title: string, date: string | null } | null, summary: string | null, summaryMeta: string | null, mentions: { id: string, type: string, name: string }[], threads: string[] }
